messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: problem installing rstanarm@master, but not rstanarm@
parts:
Hello,

I have been using rstanarm a bit lately and find it very useful!

In the context of dealing with problems to use posterior_predict for new data
I tried to install the current rstanarm version (2.8.1), and got following (error) message:

> install_github("stan-dev/rstanarm", ref = "master")
Downloading GitHub repo stan-dev/rstanarm@master
Installing rstanarm
Skipping 1 packages ahead of CRAN: rstan
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/bin/x64/R" --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save --no-restore CMD INSTALL  \
  "C:/Users/gubi/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpWIFcYf/devtools758146367ce/stan-dev-rstanarm-bbe1ef5" --library="C:/Program  \
  Files/R/R-3.2.2/library" --install-tests 

* installing *source* package 'rstanarm' ...
** libs

*** arch - i386
no DLL was created
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'rstanarm'
* removing 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.2/library/rstanarm'
Error: Command failed (1)


I can actually install the older "glmer-and-horseshoe" branch, and am also able to compile 
models for rstan 2.8.1.


Does anybody have an idea what could cause the problem when trying to install
rstanarm 2.8.1?

Thanks in advance!

Guido
